2608.27367.title: Successive Capacity Growth: Task-Complexity-Driven Width and Depth Expansion for Vision Transformer Encoders in JEPA World Models
2608.27367.paper_summary: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) for world modeling typically employ fixed-size Vision Transformer encoders that are over-provisioned for simple tasks and under-provisioned for complex ones, with significant redundancy across attention heads. We propose Successive Capacity Growth (SCG), a method that starts from a minimal encoder (1 head, 2 layers, 283K parameters) and grows incrementally in width (adding attention heads for low-level semantic capacity) or depth (adding transformer blocks for higher-order semantic abstraction), driven by a task-agnostic test-and-verify mechanism that exploits function-preserving expansion to safely trial architectural changes and roll back if they do not improve prediction loss. The Sketched Isotropic Gaussian Regularizer (SIGReg) ensures that all learned semantic dimensions remain statistically independent and aligned with the predictive objective, preventing collapse even as the architecture grows. On a 60-dimensional multi-object dynamics task, SCG naturally triggers depth expansion, improving prediction loss by 20.3% over the fixed small baseline with 56 times greater parameter efficiency than scaling to the fixed large model; on a 2D navigation task, a single width expansion yields even an 23% improvement over the fixed large model. Across all three tested environments of increasing complexity, the adaptive encoder matches or exceeds the fixed small baseline, with zero false-positive expansions and bit-exact function preservation (ratio = 1.0, absolute difference = 0.0). The take-away is that JEPA world model encoders need not be pre-allocated at maximum capacity - they can grow successively as the task demands, achieving significant compute and data efficiency while maintaining representation quality.
2608.27367.paper_summary_zh: 聯合嵌入預測架構（JEPAs）用於世界建模時，通常使用固定大小的視覺Transformer編碼器，這些編碼器對於簡單任務過度配置，對於複雜任務則配置不足，且在注意力頭之間存在顯著的冗餘。我們提出了逐步容量增長（SCG）方法，從最小編碼器（1個頭，2層，283K參數）開始，並根據需要逐步增加寬度（為低級語義容量添加注意力頭）或深度（為高級語義抽象添加Transformer塊），這一過程由一種與任務無關的測試和驗證機制驅動，利用保留功能的擴展安全地試驗架構變更，並在未改善預測損失的情況下回滾。草圖各向同性高斯正則化器（SIGReg）確保所有學習的語義維度在統計上保持獨立，並與預測目標對齊，即使在架構增長的情況下也能防止崩潰。在一個60維的多物體動態任務中，SCG自然觸發深度擴展，預測損失比固定的小基線改善了20.3%，且其參數效率比擴展到固定的大模型高出56倍；在一個2D導航任務中，單次寬度擴展甚至使預測損失比固定的大模型改善了23%。在所有三個測試的環境中，隨著複雜性增加，自適應編碼器的表現與固定的小基線相匹配或超過，且沒有虛假擴展，功能保持的比率為1.0，絕對差異為0.0。結論是，JEPA世界模型編碼器不必預先分配到最大容量——它們可以根據任務需求逐步增長，在保持表示質量的同時實現顯著的計算和數據效率。
2608.27367.author: Frederik Berenz et.al.
